## No charge for the basics

Straightforward pricing for every plan

- ### Security


SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified infrastructure, with regular audits and testing.

- ### Per-second billing


Billed on connected time, with no minimums and no rounding up to the minute.

- ### Model upgrades


New versions of the models on this page as they ship, with no migration project.

- ### Integrations


Pre-built connectors with the tools you already run, or any API or MCP server.

- ### Telephony


Carrier-grade voice on your numbers or ours. Your own carrier connects over SIP at no charge.

- ### Channels


Voice, chat and messaging on the same platform and the same agents.

- ### Testing


Test calls, simulated conversations and A/B tests on live traffic, at no extra charge.

- ### Monitoring


Latency and cost per agent on the console, in real time.
